title: LVLM-Compress-Bench: Benchmarking the Broader Impact of Large Vision-Language Model Compression

bias_targets.methodology: Using the PAIRS dataset to present synthetic, visually ambiguous images differing by gender, probing the model with occupational questions (Gender-Occupation Bias), and calculating association scores. Additionally, using the SocialCounterfactuals dataset to measure disparities in toxicity, competence, and stereotypes via keyword generation prompts.

Using the PAIRS dataset with synthetic images differing by race (Black, White) and probing the model with status-related (Race-Status Bias) and crime-related (Race-Crime Bias) questions to calculate stereotypical association scores.

Using the SocialCounterfactuals dataset containing images varying by physical attributes (old, young, obese, skinny, tattooed) to measure disparities in MaxToxicity, Competence, and Stereotype metrics based on generated descriptive keywords.
